definition.def: Your ancestors are the people from whom you are descended.
examples: ...our daily lives, so different from those of our ancestors.
He could trace his ancestors back seven hundred years.

definition.def: An ancestor of something modern is an earlier thing from which it developed.
examples: The direct ancestor of the modern cat was the Kaffir cat of ancient Egypt. [+ of]
The immediate ancestor of rock 'n' roll is rhythm-and-blues.

examples.sentence: Explorer Roy Chapman Andrews argued at the time that the whale must be a throwback to a land-living ancestor.
From a detailed analysis of the salamanders' family tree, however, it is clear that the other lineages evolved from an ancestor that itself had lost the ability to metamorphose.
There is evidence that all modern turtles are descended from a terrestrial ancestor which lived before most of the dinosaurs.
Venus flytraps, for example, share an ancestor with Portuguese sundews, which only catch prey passively, via 'flypaper' glands on their stems.
They share a more recent ancestor with Drosera sundews, which can also curl their leaves over their prey.
